world.title: Saudi Arabia claims Houthis tried to attack its capital Riyadh with missiles
world.summary: Saudi Arabia reported that Yemen's Houthi rebels attempted to launch a ballistic missile at its capital, Riyadh, marking the first such attack on the city. The missile was intercepted before it could reach its target. This incident highlights ongoing tensions in the region, as Saudi Arabia continues to face threats from the Houthi group amid the ongoing conflict in Yemen.

world.title: If Washington wants to escape quagmire...: Iran's 7 conditions to end war
world.summary: Iran has communicated seven conditions to the United States via Qatari mediators, seeking to initiate negotiations to end the ongoing war. The message emphasizes the importance of dialogue while simultaneously warning that Tehran is prepared for a "decisive war" if its terms are not accepted. The conditions reflect Iran's stance on the conflict's resolution.

world.title: Saudi Arabia confirms Yemen’s Houthi rebels tried to attack its capital with ballistic missile
world.summary: Saudi Arabia confirmed on September 19, 2026, that Yemen's Houthi rebels attempted to launch a ballistic missile at Riyadh. This incident marks a significant escalation in the ongoing regional tensions between Saudi Arabia and the Tehran-backed Houthi group. It is the first missile attack targeting the capital since the recent intensification of hostilities in the region.

business.title: Bilibili, 'China's YouTube', draws Indian creators despite no India launch, as India-China ties thaw and YouTube monetisation set to tighten
business.summary: Indian creators are increasingly using China's Bilibili, known as "China's YouTube," to share content despite the platform not being officially available in India. They employ workarounds like VPNs and altered location settings to access the site. This trend emerges as India-China relations improve and YouTube's monetization policies become stricter, prompting creators to seek alternative platforms for revenue.

business.title: Why the global panic over AI is not a crisis over technology
business.summary: The global concern regarding AI is not merely a technological crisis but a challenge to redefine human value. Education has traditionally focused on mastering curricula and accumulating knowledge, which was thought to ensure student success. However, the emergence of AI necessitates a reevaluation of these educational paradigms, moving beyond fear and fatalism to address the evolving role of human intellect.

business.title: Europe Outbids Asia for LNG as Prices Surge 150%
business.summary: Liquefied natural gas prices on the spot market have surged by 150% due to increased seasonal demand and declining interest from Asian importers. In response, European buyers are intensifying their purchases despite the high costs, driven by necessity. The shift in demand dynamics highlights the changing landscape of global LNG markets amid fluctuating prices and regional preferences.

technology.title: IT admins can now remotely “Sanitize” PCs and reinstall Windows 11, thanks to two new features in Cloud Rebuild
technology.summary: Microsoft's Windows 11 Build 26340 introduces enhancements to the Cloud Rebuild tool for IT administrators. The new features include hardware-level drive sanitization, allowing for secure data removal, and remote deployment via Recovery CSP, enabling easier reinstallation of Windows 11. These updates aim to streamline the recovery process and improve management capabilities for IT professionals.

technology.title: EA FC 27 Season 1 Premium Pass: Price, rewards, and more
technology.summary: EA Sports FC 27 has launched its first Ones to Watch season, introducing the Season 1 Premium Pass. This pass features a reward track that includes various player items, packs, and Evolutions. Players can access exclusive content and rewards as they progress through the season. The Premium Pass aims to enhance the gaming experience for participants.

technology.title: iPhone 18 Pro Battery Replacement Cost in India Rises to Rs 13,900
technology.summary: Apple has raised the out-of-warranty battery replacement cost for the iPhone 18 Pro and iPhone 18 Pro Max in India to Rs 13,900. This increase is significant for users planning to retain their devices long-term, as it adds to the overall expense of ownership. The higher service cost follows the already substantial initial purchase price of the devices.

sports.title: Asian Games 2026 Day 2 LIVE Updates: India bag shooting silver, Suchika assures MMA medal; hockey team scores 19
sports.summary: On Day 2 of the Asian Games 2026 in Aichi-Nagoya, India secured a silver medal in shooting and Suchika has guaranteed a medal in MMA. The Indian hockey team achieved a record victory, scoring 19 goals. Updates on India's performance continue to be provided as the event progresses, highlighting significant achievements in various sports disciplines.

sports.title: Xabi Alonso disappointed with Chelsea’s ‘competitive mentality’ in Brentford defeat
sports.summary: Xabi Alonso expressed disappointment with Chelsea's lack of competitive mentality during their defeat to Brentford. He highlighted the team's inconsistency and emphasized the importance of small details in matches. Alonso noted that giving advantages in such games is detrimental, acknowledging Brentford's ability to capitalize on limited opportunities. He stressed the need for improvement in future performances.

sports.title: Sevilla 1-3 Barcelona: Raphinha scores another hat-trick as La Liga leaders stay perfect
sports.summary: Barcelona secured their seventh consecutive win in La Liga, defeating Sevilla 3-1. After trailing in the first half, Raphinha scored a hat-trick to lead the comeback. The victory maintains Barcelona's perfect start to the season, showcasing their resilience and dominance in the match. This performance solidifies their position at the top of the La Liga standings.

health.title: Don’t sip that tea very hot
health.summary: Research indicates that consuming very hot beverages, particularly tea, is associated with an increased risk of esophageal cancer. The International Agency for Research on Cancer (IARC) categorizes drinks served above 65 degrees Celsius as potentially carcinogenic. However, the risk increase is not uniform for all individuals who drink hot tea, and further studies are needed for definitive conclusions.

health.title: Chronic Stress Linked to Hidden Heart Inflammation Risk
health.summary: A UK study published in the European Journal of Preventive Cardiology reveals that chronic stress may lead to hidden heart inflammation, potentially increasing the risk of heart damage. The research highlights the importance of recognizing stress as a significant factor in cardiovascular health, suggesting that earlier prevention strategies could be beneficial in mitigating these risks associated with chronic stress.

health.title: Synergistically modified boron sludge-based magnesium oxysulfate cement for rapid road repair
health.summary: A new magnesium oxysulfate cement, modified with boron sludge, has been developed for rapid road repair. This study highlights the synergistic effects of boron mud, mineral admixtures, and polymers. Optimal performance occurs with 10% boron sludge, achieving ideal setting times and high compressive strength. The research supports sustainable waste recycling and the creation of effective road repair materials.

science.title: T. rex had a body temperature of 36.3°C, almost the same as humans; fossil tooth chemistry reveals the 66-million-year-old predator was warm-blooded and could survive in cold climates
science.summary: A recent study has revealed that Tyrannosaurus rex had a body temperature of 36.3°C, similar to humans, indicating it was warm-blooded. This discovery, based on fossil tooth chemistry, suggests that T. rex could survive in colder climates. The findings provide new insights into the physiology of this 66-million-year-old predator, challenging previous assumptions about its temperature regulation.

science.title: The T. rex had a body temperature similar to our own, study finds
science.summary: Scientists have determined that the body temperature of Tyrannosaurus rex was similar to that of modern mammals, using fossilized teeth for analysis. This finding contrasts with earlier beliefs that dinosaurs were cold-blooded and sluggish. Current research supports the idea that many dinosaurs, including T. rex, were warm-blooded and capable of regulating their body temperature effectively.

science.title: 4 Google Maps tasks that are easier on a PC
science.summary: Using Google Maps on a PC offers advantages over mobile devices for certain tasks. Users benefit from a larger display, allowing for a more comprehensive view of maps. This enhances navigation and planning experiences. Specific tasks, such as route planning, searching for locations, and viewing multiple destinations, are often more manageable and efficient on a computer than on a smartphone.

entertainment.title: Capricorn Horoscope Today: September 20, 2026
entertainment.summary: Capricorns are encouraged to embrace freedom and assert their individuality today. Feeling constrained by structure may lead to discomfort. Engaging in outdoor activities such as running or walking, along with enjoying fresh air and sunshine, is advised to improve mood and well-being. Taking time for oneself can help alleviate feelings of being trapped or boxed in.

entertainment.title: Leo Horoscope Today: September 20, 2026
entertainment.summary: On September 20, 2026, Leos are encouraged to focus on self-care during challenging times. While difficulties may arise, support from loved ones can provide comfort. Adopting a slower, more intentional pace in life is advised, reinforcing personal strength and resilience. Emphasizing emotional connections and nurturing relationships will help navigate any obstacles faced today.

entertainment.title: Sagittarius Horoscope Today: September 20, 2026
entertainment.summary: On September 20, 2026, Sagittarius is encouraged to focus on love in various forms. This includes appreciating simple gestures like a hug from a pet, the beauty of a blooming plant, or a caring message from a friend. The horoscope emphasizes that love manifests in many ways, highlighting its importance in daily life and emotional well-being.
